Counts overlap and are not added. Downstream Smoke/assets and dependent steps that CI skipped after an earlier failure were **not executed**, and are recorded separately from test skips in the JSON. Canonical failure artifacts independently confirm tofu/platform/workflows/workflow-intents counts and failed verdicts. Non-passing required records cannot be read as a count of failed assertions.

The strongest source-supported defect is the new external-effects CHECK regex `{1,256}` at `src/lib/controlplane/db/migrations/0033_external_effects.ts:25,28`. PostgreSQL16 permits repetition bounds only0–255; native CI reports invalid repetition counts in external-effect paths, including the ACR journal. This is a SQL/source incompatibility, not a tool timeout. [PostgreSQL16 regex syntax](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/functions-matching.html#POSIX-SYNTAX-DETAILS).

A separate new executable-semantics guard at `src/lib/capabilities/approvals.ts:155–156` refuses existing plan approval/deploy compositions whose supplied digest differs from recorded review semantics. Builder-owned DUR03 callers/fixtures need review; weakening the guard is not proposed. The two workflow-intent migration12/schema6 tombstone cases encounter a missing standing-grant table or migration refusal before their intended fault; compatibility review belongs to the migration owner.

Tofu's five failed cases cover Azure image identity1, ACR journal2 and OCI independently-confirmed cleanup2. Generated's six failures are operator-guide drift (index/source pin, KEY-CUSTODY, teardown, Azure composition, repository paths and current app wiring). Remaining unit/workflow failures include workflow export/sandbox expectations and authority/read/manifest/egress/TLS integration assertions; this bounded review does not claim that one root cause explains every260 unit or248 platform failures.

No test/hook timeout, TimeoutError, out-of-memory or connection-refusal marker was observed in bounded failed-job logs. All six failures have genuine assertion/schema/refusal evidence; not every individual case has an independently completed root-cause analysis.
